description: This file defines the 'RequiredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterStrategy' class, which is a placement filter strategy in Orleans for matching silo metadata based on specified keys. It includes methods for initialization and retrieving additional grain properties related to metadata keys.

classes.name: RequiredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterStrategy
classes.description: A placement filter strategy class that filters based on silo metadata matching specified keys. It extends PlacementFilterStrategy and provides functionality to initialize metadata keys and retrieve related grain properties.

methods.name: RequiredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterStrategy
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the strategy with specified metadata keys and order.

methods.name: AdditionalInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the strategy with grain properties, extracting metadata keys from the properties.

methods.name: GetAdditionalGrainProperties
methods.description: Generates additional grain properties, specifically returning the metadata keys as a comma-separated string.
